message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Operating Leverage Shift", "construction": "Change in (Gross Profit / Sales) over the past 2 quarters, divided by average (Gross Profit / Sales) over the past 3 years, using Compustat quarterly data.", "rationale": "Sudden shifts in operating leverage may signal under- or over-investment in productive capacity not yet reflected in prices.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with recent large increases in the ratio"}, {"name": "Inventory-to-Order Backlog Ratio", "construction": "Latest quarterly Inventory (Compustat) divided by Order Backlog (Compustat, where reported), winsorized at 1st and 99th percentiles.", "rationale": "A high ratio may indicate overproduction or weak demand, while a low ratio could signal strong demand and potential future pricing power.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low inventory-to-order backlog ratios"}, {"name": "Insider Option Exercise Disadvantage", "construction": "Count of insider option exercises (Form 4) over the past 12 months occurring at strike prices above current market price, normalized by total option exercises.", "rationale": "Executives exercising underwater options may lack timing skill or face liquidity needs, which could signal undervaluation or expected outperformance.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with higher proportions of underwater option exercises"}, {"name": "Negative Working Capital Momentum", "construction": "3-month change in (Current Assets - Current Liabilities) scaled by Total Assets, using Compustat quarterly data.", "rationale": "Rapid improvements in working capital position may precede positive earnings surprises or improved operating performance.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with the largest positive change in working capital momentum"}, {"name": "Patent Citation Growth", "construction": "Year-on-year growth in total forward citations to a firm's patents (USPTO data), scaled by the firm's total assets.", "rationale": "Rising patent citations signal innovation and future competitive advantage, predicting superior long-term stock performance.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with highest growth in patent citations relative to assets"}, {"name": "Abnormal Deferred Revenue Increase", "construction": "Change in deferred revenue (Compustat) over the past year, divided by average historical annual deferred revenue growth over the prior 5 years.", "rationale": "Unusually large increases in deferred revenue may reflect robust customer demand and pricing power, especially for software or service firms.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with the highest abnormal deferred revenue growth"}, {"name": "Compensation-to-Profit Divergence", "construction": "1-year growth in total compensation expense (Compustat) minus 1-year growth in net income, scaled by trailing 1-year net income.", "rationale": "Disproportionately rising compensation relative to profits may signal future mean reversion or agency issues.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with negative compensation-to-profit divergence (compensation rising slower than profits)"}, {"name": "Customer Concentration Change", "construction": "Year-over-year change in the share of sales to the top three customers (from 10-K segment disclosures).", "rationale": "Decreasing dependence on major customers may reduce business risk and signal diversification of revenue streams.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with the largest decrease in customer concentration"}, {"name": "Net Share Buyback Surprise", "construction": "Difference between actual net share repurchases (Compustat Cash Flow Statement) in the past 12 months and the average annual net buybacks over the previous 3 years, scaled by market cap.", "rationale": "Surprisingly aggressive buyback activity may indicate undervaluation or management confidence.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with the highest positive net buyback surprises"}, {"name": "Post-Spin-Off Asset Turnover Jump", "construction": "Change in Asset Turnover (Sales / Total Assets, Compustat) from 1 year pre-spin to 1 year post-spin for firms undergoing spin-offs (identified via press releases and Compustat data).", "rationale": "Improved efficiency and focus following a spin-off may not be immediately priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with the largest positive jumps in asset turnover after spin-offs"}]}
